intro.text: A deserter from Highprince Sadeas's army whom Shallan Davar takes into her service on the Shattered Plains.
A former soldier in Shallan Davar's guard, trained alongside Gaz and Vathah as a spy.
A Lightweaver and member of Shallan's Unseen Court, once a deserter from Sadeas's army.

items.text: Red came from Farcoast in Highprince Vamah's princedom, near Jah Keved. When Vamah called the city to arms, Red enlisted with five friends, partly for revenge and partly because any man without a recruit patch looked like a coward.

Red deserted from Highprince Sadeas's army on the Shattered Plains, feeling the war had stopped being about vengeance and become a game for lighteyes chasing spheres. Shallan picked him up with the other deserters.
In Urithiru Red mostly lounged in the common room gambling with the rest of Shallan's guard. He didn't mind having little to do, not feeling he deserved to be honour guard to a Knight Radiant.

Red was one of three men, with Gaz and Vathah, chosen to train as spies under Ishnah, and was most interested in knives. Asked to describe the people in a tavern with his eyes shut, he mocked Gaz instead, but then made a real effort for Shallan's sake, nodding along even when confused.
Because of his training, Red was chosen with Vathah to go to Kholinar and was flown there, bundled up like everyone else.

Only Shallan and Elhokar knew Red had come to Kholinar to help gather information. When he learned that Veil and Shallan were the same person, he simply laughed. He spent most of his time with Ishnah and Vathah, continuing his training.

Red learned to tell Veil and Vathah when it was safe to attempt their heists. When Veil was shot in the head by a crossbow bolt and unharmed, he could only remark that the blood was staining her outfit, and he stayed silent the rest of the day. He kept helping on her food raids afterwards.

Red was left behind in Kholinar with Ishnah and Vathah. He found a merchant with a spanreed, and after the Battle of Thaylen Field Kaladin picked up his group, along with Skar, Drehy and little Gavinor.

Posing as a darkeyed workman, Red infiltrated the Sons of Honor but wasn't considered important enough to meet Ialai Sadeas. When Shallan got in under another disguise, Red was among those who questioned her, though he did not go with the group to the Sadeas warcamp.

Red, by now a Lightweaver, was left in charge of the Unseen Court when Shallan went to Lasting Integrity. Navani called on him to identify Dabbid after he was caught delivering a strange spanreed, and Red was among the first Surgebinders to collapse when the tower was occupied.

appearance.text: Red is a tall, lanky Alethi man with a beard and light violet eyes. Despite his nickname, his hair isn't red. He was once a darkeyes, and wears a darkeyed worker's brown trousers, a buttoned shirt with rolled sleeves and bright suspenders.

personality.text: Red laughs easily and enjoys Shallan's jokes. He likes to chat and lounge, yet takes pride in doing a job well and is often the first to start working.

Friendly and cheerful, Red likes making friends, drinking and gambling, though like most Alethi he can't stand Horneater lager. He is the friendliest of Shallan's guards, briefly tries flirting with Veil, shares his drink ration with her, and won't join the others in complaining about Shallan.
